text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A battle against Yaeno Muteki. Giving 
everything she had built up thus far, 
Sakura Chiyono O emerged victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Precisely because both gave it their 
all, the victor rejoices with all her 
might, while the defeated Yaeno Muteki 
sheds tears of bitter frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is deeply moved, 
realizing just how much competing against 
a rival can stir one's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And watching their race from the stands, 
Mejiro Ardan fired up her fighting spirit 
for one of the few decisive battlegrounds 
permitted to her... the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Japanese Derby. It is 
the defining race for Sakura Chiyono O.
